text.title: Yacine's New Habit
body: Yacine used to spend most of his free time playing video games at home.
He rarely went outside, and he often felt tired and weak.
Last year, his older brother bought him a bicycle for his birthday.
Yacine's brother is an avid cyclist who never misses a training session, rain or shine.
At first, Yacine found cycling difficult, and he could only ride for ten minutes.
His brother told him to practise every day and never give up.
Slowly, Yacine became stronger, and cycling became easy for him.
Now, he rides his bicycle every morning before school, and he feels full of energy all day.
His classmates say he looks healthier than before.
Yacine has also made new friends at the local cycling club.
He plans to enter a small race in his town next spring.
His brother is very proud of the change in Yacine's life.
